2073-3698-7876-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Consulate Dreadnought from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Kolodin trigger, causing Consulate Dreadnought to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Consulate Dreadnought.
When Consulate Dreadnought dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
